slides.headline: Is the blue on your van the *same* blue as your website?
slides.sub: If you had to go and check, this one's for you.

slides.title: Pick a small set of colours
slides.sub: One main colour, one accent, a light and a dark. That's plenty.

slides.title: Then use the exact codes everywhere
items: Give your web designer the code, like #173A5E, so nobody picks a blue by eye.
Ask your printer which version of the code they need.
Same colours on your posts, quotes and invoices.

slides.headline: Save the codes where *everyone* can find them.
slides.sub: A note on your phone is fine. Then nobody has to guess the blue again.
